purpose: Secondary metadata and statement-reference review for ten remaining unresolved candidates. No source is promoted to original-statement verified unless the exact statement was captured and provenance matches.

records.title: Classrooms

sources.observation: Contains a matching Classrooms statement: maximize the number of proposed activities assigned across k classrooms, with activity start/end times and non-overlap constraints.
Identifies Kattis classrooms and Hong Kong Regional Online Preliminary 2016 as the source.

observedContent.constraints: k <= n <= 200000; activity start and finish times are each within 1..10^9.
observedContent.output: Maximum number of activities that can be scheduled.

records.rationale: The available statement mirror is a short single-objective resource-allocation problem. It is a valid scheduling exercise, but the narrative/task breadth appears insufficient for the long-scenario quota. Original-host statement still not captured.

records.title: Wood Cutting

sources.observation: Lists Wood Cutting / woodcutting under Alberta Collegiate Programming Contest 2016.
Describes grouping each customer's wood pieces, summing their sizes, sorting customers by total cutting time, and minimizing average waiting time. This is not the original statement.

records.rationale: Problem identity and contest metadata are corroborated. The solution explanation suggests a compact shortest-processing-time scheduling task, but without the statement this is not a final scenario-depth rejection.

records.title: Single source shortest path, time table

sources.observation: Identifies Kattis problem shortestpath2 as a timetable-graph extension to Dijkstra, where edges can only be used at specified times. This is a course exercise page, not the original contest statement.
Repeats the timetable-graph assignment and Kattis problem ID.

records.rationale: The task is described as a graph-algorithm exercise, but the candidate's claimed KTH CSC Popup 2005 provenance has not been corroborated. Do not count this course description as an original contest statement.
